Tess: Heads-up — my docs PR (#3422) is failing the CI sentence-case check on migration-guide.md. Preview site still built, but the linter step returned non-zero.
Alex: Ugh, saw that. CI log shows a 'SentenceCase' rule violation in a heading and a spellcheck warning for a possessive. Can you paste the exact output?
Tess: Pasted below (from docs-lint step):
```
docs-lint: ERROR migration-guide.md:45 - SentenceCase: heading 'what is Redwood's serving runtime' -> should start with capital 'What is Redwood's serving runtime'
docs-spell: WARN migration-guide.md:45 - Possessive form flagged: "Redwood's" (custom-dict not loaded)
```
Sam: Two quick options: 1) fix the heading to sentence case (easy), 2) if this file is intentionally title-cased for headings, we can add an exception in .docs-lint.toml to skip SentenceCase for /docs/migration/**. Which do you prefer?
Tess: The heading is meant to be a short question, so fixing to sentence case is fine. But the spellcheck warn worries me — we've seen the custom-dict not loading in CI before.
Alex: I can push a tiny patch to normalize the heading. For the spellcheck: CI is not loading the repo-level custom dictionary when the preview runs from forks — our policy is not to rely on fork mounting. We should either add an inline dictionary entry or adjust the spell rule for now.
Leo: Re: policy — we agreed not to widen CI exceptions for forks. Short-term, add a spellcheck ignore pragma on that line, then open a follow-up in infra to fix the custom dict for preview runners.
Tess: OK. Plan: Alex will change the heading, add a one-line spellignore comment, and push. We'll hold merge until CI is green. Also flagging for reviewer availability — @Sam and @Leo, can one of you approve once CI passes?
Sam: I can review after CI. If the change is tiny, I'll approve quick.
ci-bot: docs/preview — build passed; docs-lint — failed (exit code 2). Full logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/9876
Alex: Pushing patch in branch now. Diff:
```
- ### what is Redwood's serving runtime
+ ### What is Redwood's serving runtime
<!-- docs-spell: ignore-line -->
```
Alex: Pushed and triggered CI re-run.
docs-bot: Preview deploy created — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3422 
ci-bot: Re-run: docs-lint — running...
ci-bot: docs-lint — SUCCESS (0 warnings)
Tess: Nice. @Sam can you review when you get a sec? If approved, I'll merge into the next docs weekly window (12:30-13:30 PST).
Sam: Reviewing now. Small nit: prefer full stop at end of that heading? Not necessary for headings. Approving. :+1:
Tess: Thanks. Merging after quick smoke check.
ci-bot: Merge queued — will merge at next docs merge slot.
Tess: Merged and backported the tiny fix to the v1 migration copy. Thanks all — opening infra follow-up to get the custom-dict loading fixed for fork previews so spell warnings don't block small edits.
Leo: Filing the infra ticket now (INFRA-2019).
